body.x: Cosmos Lab participated in the Future Innovation Tech Expo 2024 (FIX 2024), held from October 23 to 26 at Daegu EXCO.

Cosmos Lab’s slogan embraces the values of challenge and innovation in sustainable energy solutions. According to the company, “Deep Dive” represents the depth of expertise of elite researchers and their commitment to energy solutions. At the same time, “Great Impact” signifies the company’s vision to positively influence the global energy industry.

At the exhibition, Cosmos Lab introduced its Aqueous Zinc-Bromine Battery, which offers key advantages such as no risk of catastrophic failure, thermal runaway, or fire spread. Its electrolyte can suppress fires in the event of damage and poses no dangers during handling or disposal.

Cosmos Lab stated, “Our 100% non-flammable water-based battery provides users with a stable battery environment. It offers high efficiency and long-term performance in extreme conditions like low or high temperatures. Our battery technology is globally viable and safe.”

They added, “We also use cost-effective raw materials by recycling wood waste and diversifying supply chains. In addition, our eco-friendly dry manufacturing process provides the best technology for the future, promoting a lifestyle that harmonizes humanity with nature.”

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Start-up Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
